Senses.Explanation: Literally, 駟馬難追 says that even a team of four horses cannot catch it. The recurrent full wording supplies the omitted object: once a word has gone out, the horses cannot retrieve it. Chan masters use the saying as an answer in public exchanges, not merely as a warning to think before speaking. Cuiyan Shouzhi presents it as his house style. Tian'an Sheng gives it when asked what his opening furnace could refine if everyone already possesses what is needed. Yunfeng uses it to answer what the flower held up at Vulture Peak meant, and follows the question about Mahakasyapa's smile with 'the mouth is the gate of trouble.' Xuedou Chongxian gives the saying after his interlocutor declares that he has met the teacher. A later lamp preserves Foyin Liaoyuan replying with it when a student says he still does not understand. Across these exchanges, masters give the already-issued saying itself as their response; the phrase does not prescribe one fixed doctrinal answer.
